tonight.headline: Claims lock at 02:00 — your D/ST is a bye
body: Bad news first. Your D/ST is Green Bay on bye and only a waiver claim fixes it — claims process at 02:00 tonight (Wed 18 Nov CDMX), and Wednesday morning's brief is too late. Waddle still has no practice line since his concussion, and Warren was out-routed 20 to 12 by Dowdle in Week 10.

ESPN projects 127.6 to 100.8 and gives you 64%, but Panda Attack start two byes (DeMario Douglas, Harold Fannin Jr.) with Cam Skattebo (14.5) on their bench — filled, their real number is near 120. The D/ST seat is the difference.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Panda Attack slide Skattebo into the flex and stream a tight end for Fannin: roughly 100.8 + 14.5 + 8 ≈ 123 against your 127.6 with a zero at D/ST (league file).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A D/ST claim landing tonight adds about 9 projected points; if every claim fails, add the best free-agent D/ST after 02:00 and before Sunday 12:00.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Claims process Wed 18 Nov 02:00 CDMX — tonight
doFirst.title: Claim the Steelers D/ST, drop the Packers D/ST
doFirst.subtitle: Then Chiefs, then Jets, then Bears — each dropping the Packers. The window closes overnight.

case.label: The hole
case.body: Green Bay are on bye, so the Packers D/ST score 0.0 and you carry no second defence. Every unrostered player in Chem is on waivers until Wed 18 Nov 02:00 CDMX (league file, 22:05Z) — a claim is the only way in before then.

case.label: The pick
case.body: Steelers D/ST, 9.4 projected, the best on the wire. Philadelphia have lost six straight and benched Tanner McKee for Joe Milton (Yahoo 4 Nov); NBC's Week 11 D/ST rankings have Milton under centre against Pittsburgh and call it favourable while DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks stay out (Yahoo/NBC 17 Nov 15:51Z). This morning's card said McKee — that was wrong; the case is the same or better.

case.label: The chain
case.body: Chem priority resets weekly, so stack four claims, each dropping the Packers, in projection order: Steelers (9.4), Chiefs (9.0) at home to Carson Beck — Arizona's 12.5 implied total is the slate's lowest (Yahoo/NBC 17 Nov) — then Jets (7.9) at the Chargers, then Bears (7.5) at home to a Saints line missing Taliese Fuaga and Erik McCoy (Yahoo/NBC 17 Nov). Only one lands.

case.label: Contested
case.body: NBC ranks the Chiefs 1st and the Steelers 5th this week. Steelers–Chiefs is 0.4 apart on ESPN's projection — a coin flip, which goes to the projection with no thesis. If you already entered the Chiefs first, leave it.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The D/ST you end up with scores under 5, or (if the Steelers land) the Chiefs D/ST outscore them in Week 11 (archive).

action.label: Claim Steelers D/ST · drop Packers D/ST

whatWentWrong.title: This morning's claim card named the wrong Eagles quarterback
whatWentWrong.lead: It said Tanner McKee starts for Philadelphia. The Eagles benched McKee for Joe Milton on 4 Nov.

case.label: What happened
case.body: The 07:00 brief cited Yahoo from 19 Oct and 16 Nov for McKee. Yahoo reported the switch to Milton on 4 Nov, and NBC's 17 Nov D/ST column names Milton against Pittsburgh.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing in the action — the Steelers are still the first claim — but the card above now carries the right reason.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Philadelphia naming McKee or another starter on Wednesday; the Steelers would stay first on projection either way.

whatWentWrong.title: The free-agent D/ST plan died at the rollover
whatWentWrong.lead: Monday's brief planned a free-agent add. Every free agent went to waivers when Week 11 opened, so it is a claim — tonight.

case.label: What happened
case.body: All unrostered players in Chem show WAIVERS, clearing Wed 08:00Z (league file, 22:05Z). The Packers scored 4 in Week 10 against the Giants' 5 (archive) and are on bye now.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The claim card above. A claim costs nothing lasting in Chem, but order still matters — by projection, not by when the idea came.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: If every claim fails, the free-agent window opens at 02:00 Wednesday: add the highest-projected D/ST left before Sunday 12:00.

worthALook.name: Xavier Hutchinson
worthALook.lead: Houston's slot receiver while Marvin Harrison Jr. is hurt.

case.label: The player
case.body: 9 targets, a 24% share, in Week 10 (NBC 16 Nov); 80%+ of routes two weeks running and a touchdown in three straight (DraftSharks via FF Hound).

case.label: What would change it

case.label: What would change it

waiverAnalysis.summary: Ten weeks of data, measured against Denzel Boston — the weakest movable receiver, on bye with 2 targets in Week 10. Four receivers rise; research gives none a durable role this roster lacks. The only claim tonight is the D/ST.
